entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A warrior and planeswalker, once a bounty hunter, who tracks Chandra to Zendikar, helps defend Fort Keff, and leaves to find the Gatewatch-style organization of planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A headstrong pyromancer and planeswalker whom Gideon once captured and now seeks on Zendikar to make amends.

entities.name: Tafre
entities.description: A scarred adventurer and storyteller, a trapfinder for the Akoum Expeditionary House, who shares his fire with Gideon and tells of a field of flesh.

entities.name: Gideon's teacher
entities.description: The powerful mage who took young Gideon under his wing and taught him to hone his skills and the teaching of pain, death and honor.

entities.name: Captain of the guard of Fort Keff
entities.description: The honest, overwhelmed captain of Fort Keff who refuses to listen to Gideon about the surrakar until the battle.

entities.name: Surrakar prisoner
entities.description: A captured surrakar who speaks of coming gods and begs to be killed, and whom Gideon has released to guide the survivors out.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who lured Jace and Chandra to Zendikar as part of future plans.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker lured to Zendikar by Nicol Bolas in pursuit of the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: One of Bolas's minions, who battled Chandra at the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A planeswalker who arrived on Zendikar and joined Nissa on a journey to reach the Eye of Ugin.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf warrior who broke the Eye of Ugin entirely, freeing the Eldrazi Titans.

entities.name: Eldrazi Titan
entities.description: A colossal, 150-foot-tall tentacled being, called a god by the surrakar, that drifts across the horizon and reduces the land to dust.

entities.name: Eldrazi spawn
entities.description: Swarming decayed creatures with membranous bodies that attack Fort Keff behind a cloud of yellow dust.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The beings trapped within Zendikar by the Eye of Ugin, who now flood out across the plane.

entities.name: Eye of Ugin
entities.description: A mysterious chamber on Zendikar that is secretly the prison of the Eldrazi, damaged in the struggle of Jace, Chandra and Sarkhan.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A dangerous, ever-shifting plane that lures planeswalkers and kills them.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: The mountainous region of Zendikar where Fort Keff stands.

entities.name: Fort Keff
entities.description: A walled haven in Akoum built into a ravine, home to a school for healers and many young refugees.

entities.name: Sawtooth Ridge
entities.description: A ridge in Akoum near the jaddi grove where Tafre saw a field of flesh.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: A region of Zendikar where the surrakar mostly live.

entities.name: Kephalai
entities.description: The plane where Chandra destroyed the Sanctum of Stars while trying to steal a scroll.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Gideon plans to find an organization of planeswalkers.

entities.name: Order of Heliud
entities.description: A religious organization Gideon once worked for, which eventually tried to kill Chandra.

entities.name: Akoum Expeditionary House
entities.description: An expedition organization Tafre worked for as a trapfinder.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's volatile phenomenon, a colossal whirlwind, that Gideon barely escaped.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The chaotic space between planes, whose chaos Gideon sees made corporeal in the Titan.

entities.name: The Eldrazi Awaken
entities.description: The arc in which the Eldrazi are released onto Zendikar.

entities.name: The Sural
entities.description: Gideon's whip-like, multi-bladed weapon.

events.summary: Gideon, regretting how things ended with Chandra, follows her toward Zendikar, guessing she is chasing the Eye of Ugin from a stolen scroll's map.
events.quote: After a short time, he regretted the way things had ended and decided to find her.

events.summary: Gideon's tracking of Chandra dead-ends at a barren pass in Akoum.
events.quote: Chandra's trail dead-ended at a barren mountain pass in Akoum

events.summary: Gideon is admitted into Fort Keff after dark.
events.quote: "Welcome to Fort Keff, the safest haven in Akoum."

events.summary: Tafre shares his fire and tells Gideon strange stories, then describes waking in a field of flesh and burning yellow dust.
events.quote: And then I remember nothing ... until I awoke in a field of flesh.

events.summary: Gideon is woken by soldiers beating and netting a surrakar that washed up in Keff.
events.quote: Beating it with cudgels until it collapsed, the soldiers threw a weighted net over it as it screeched in an unfamiliar tongue.

events.summary: The caged surrakar grips Gideon's arm and warns that the gods are coming, asking to be killed.
events.quote: "The gods are coming," it hissed. "Kill me now."

events.summary: Refugees pour into Fort Keff, fleeing demon insects, and the captain refuses to heed Gideon's warnings about the surrakar.
participants: Captain of the guard of Fort Keff
events.quote: Refugees had been arriving at the already-crowded haven all morning.

events.summary: Gideon learns from the surrakar that the gods come from a void without color, time and boundaries and will devour all existence.
events.quote: They had been ripped from a void without color, without time, and without boundaries.

events.summary: Gideon offers to help defend the fort, and the captain agrees.
participants: Captain of the guard of Fort Keff

events.summary: A cloud of yellow dust sweeps over Fort Keff, and the Eldrazi spawn arrive at the gates.
events.quote: When the worst had past, Gideon struggled to his feet and saw that enemy was already at the gates.

events.summary: The creatures crash into the rampart, arrows prove useless, and Gideon draws his sural and leaps into the fray.
events.quote: Then he jumped into the fray.

events.summary: Gideon draws all the creatures' attention to himself and whirls his sural until the attackers lie dead and Fort Keff is saved.
A 150-foot-tall Eldrazi Titan appears on the horizon, draining color and life from the land.
events.quote: Mind-numbing, phantasmal, 150 feet tall ... a thing of madness.

events.summary: Gideon accepts that he cannot defeat the Titan and believes the surrakar spoke the truth about the Blind Eternities made corporeal.
events.quote: This was the chaos of the Blind Eternities made corporeal.

events.summary: Gideon orders the surrakar released to lead everyone out along the underground river and to flee.
participants: Captain of the guard of Fort Keff
events.quote: "Release the surrakar. He'll lead you out along the underground river. Take everyone and flee!"

events.summary: Gideon vows to return and planeswalks to Ravnica to find the planeswalkers' organization.
events.quote: Gideon whispered a vow to return and planeswalked away.

relations.note: He considers her a friend and seeks her to make amends.
relations.quote: it wasn't in his nature to desert a friend

relations.note: A powerful mage took young Gideon under his wing.
relations.quote: Then a powerful mage took young Gideon under his wing and helped him hone his skills.

relations.note: He once worked for the order as a bounty hunter.
relations.quote: Gideon was working for the Order of Heliud, a religious organization

relations.note: The order eventually tried to kill her.
relations.quote: which eventually tried to kill Chandra

relations.note: She freed the Eldrazi Titans from their prison.
relations.quote: she breaks it entirely, freeing the Eldrazi Titans from their confinement.

relations.note: He lured Jace and Chandra to Zendikar for his plans.
relations.quote: lures the Planeswalkers Jace Beleren and Chandra Nalaar to Zendikar

relations.note: The fort is the safest haven in Akoum.
relations.quote: "Welcome to Fort Keff, the safest haven in Akoum."
